title: Arknights / Endfield promotional layouts (measured study)
summary: Condensed code-drawn Latin display lettering over CJK sans/serif, one figure, a shared left line, one accent per piece, neutral grounds.

provenance.corpus: Official Arknights / Endfield promotional art, 119 sampled, 63 layout-annotated (reference only, © HYPERGRYPH)

fonts.latinDisplay: lettering.cjs: code-drawn glyphs (A-Z, 0-9, / \ - _ + . : [ ] < > | # % ! ? ' and space), rendered as paths
fonts.licence: Source Han Sans/Serif and Noto Sans/Serif CJK: SIL Open Font License 1.1
fonts.note: Fonts are named, not bundled. Install them where the SVG or PNG is rendered; check measures <text> with an advance model at or above their bold widths.

grammar: Title column on one shared left line; titles stay out of the figure zone (at most 30% of their width over it).
Latin display set in code-drawn condensed lettering; CJK title in the serif role.
One accent colour, inside the template's accent budget.

materials.placeholders: Figure, key art and logos are hatched placeholder image slots; bring the art.
materials.sources: Reference images are not redistributed; see the provenance list.

motionNote: No motion grammar measured for this corpus.
